Hi

i use actionButton to store and load data on/from a server. (input$saveButton, input$actionButton in server.R)
There are radioButtons which shall be based on the content of a directory. the path to the directory is stored in server_dir

so far i have:

datasetInput <- reactive({
    input$saveButton
       gsub(".csv", "", dir(server_dir, pattern="*.csv"))
    })

  output$radio <- renderUI({
    radioButtons("radio_id", "Choose:", datasetInput())
  })

I want to update the radio list each time the actionbutton input$saveButton ist clicked. But this does not work. Unitl now i will have to reload the whole app.

help on this would be great!
Simon

messages.subject: Re: dynamic radiobuttons based on filenames in directory
parts:
I haven't solved your specific problem, but I have done something similar in one of my own apps, so this might give you some ideas. The code snippet below selects a list of choices for the Input field, from courselist$COURSE. Every time the actiobutton is clicked, the Input field is cleared. I think the key things here are the "observe" and "updateSelectInput". There is also an updateRadioButtons (http://www.inside-r.org/packages/cran/shiny/docs/updateRadioButtons)

# ui.R

selectInput("course", label = h5("Course"), choices = courselist$COURSE, multiple=TRUE, selectize=TRUE)

actionButton("uncheckcourse", label="Clear All")

# server.R

observe({ 
        if (input$uncheckcourse > 0) {
   
        updateSelectInput(session, inputId = "course",
                      choices = courselist$COURSE)
      }
 
    })


Hope that helps!
